source_entries.title: Attention Is All You Need
short_excerpt: we share the same weight matrix between the two embedding layers and the pre-softmax linear transformation
in order for the model to make use of the order of the sequence, we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position
source_entries.inspection_note: 實讀 §3.4 的共享矩陣與 §3.5 的詞序／位置段落。只用來核共享的可行性與順序資訊的基本角色，未把原 Transformer 的正弦位置編碼說成 RoPE，未引用其效果數字。

source_entries.title: Extending Context Window of Large Language Models via Position Interpolation
locators: §2.3 Proposed Approach: Position Interpolation, Eq. (4) and Fine-tuning paragraph, pp. 4–5
§3.1 Setup and §3.2 Long Sequence Language Modeling, p. 6
short_excerpt: we reduce position indices from [0, L′) to [0, L) to match the original range of indices before computing RoPE
We fine-tune all model variants using the next token prediction objective.
source_entries.inspection_note: 實讀 Eq. (4) 的重映位置、§2.2 的未訓練長度失效風險、§2.3 微調與 §3.1–3.2 的訓練／評測分工。座標定義與長文能力不是同一證據；不把 fine-tuning 說成所有模型所有延伸法的必要條件，也不把本文數字移入教材主張。

source_entries.title: Scaling up Test-Time Compute with Latent Reasoning: A Recurrent Depth Approach
locators: §3.1 Macroscopic Design, recurrence s_i = R(e, s_{i−1}) and accompanying paragraph, pp. 2–3
§5.3 Where does recurrence help most?, p. 8
short_excerpt: the green shared recurrent block is a block of layers that is repeated to compute the final latent state
We find that saturation is highly task-dependent, on easier tasks the model saturates quicker, whereas it benefits from more compute on others.
source_entries.inspection_note: 實讀同一 R 反覆作用於更新狀態的定義、隨機輪數訓練目標，及 §5.3 對任務相關飽和的文字解釋。原文 recurrence 行與段落足以核本頁概念；未聲稱親自重現模型、親讀曲線數值或證明本課模型某輪退步。

source_entries.inspection_note: 實讀 M-RoPE 三分量、文字相同 ID、影像固定時間 ID 與影片逐 frame 的時間 ID 段落；只核多軸位置旋轉是成立的方法方向，不核模型效能及不宣稱教材重現 Qwen2-VL。
